result:
## Summary

I have successfully implemented a personal API token system for scripts with the following components:

### Database & Schema
- **`api_tokens` table** (migration: `20260929191537_create_api_tokens`)
  - Columns: `id`, `userId`, `name`, `tokenHash`, `lastUsedAt`, `createdAt`
  - Stores only SHA256 hash of tokens (never plain text)
  - Enforces user ownership via foreign key

### Models & Services
- **`ApiToken` model** (`app/Models/ApiToken.ts`)
  - Belongs to User relationship
  - Fillable: name only (userId and tokenHash are server-side)

- **`TokenService`** (`app/Services/TokenService.ts`)
  - Generates 32-character random hex tokens
  - Hashes tokens using SHA256
  - Verifies tokens against stored hashes

### Authentication & Rate Limiting
- **`BearerTokenMiddleware`** (`app/Http/Middleware/BearerTokenMiddleware.ts`)
  - Extracts bearer token from Authorization header
  - Validates token hash against database
  - Sets userId and tokenId in context for subsequent middleware
  - Returns 401 for invalid/missing tokens

- **`RateLimitMiddleware`** (`app/Http/Middleware/RateLimitMiddleware.ts`)
  - Enforces 60 requests per minute per token
  - Returns 429 with `Retry-After` header when exceeded
  - Separate rate limit buckets per token (not per user)

### API Controllers
- **`ProfileController` updates**
  - `POST /profile/tokens` - Creates token (returns 201 with token shown once)
  - `DELETE /profile/tokens/:id` - Revokes token (returns 204)

- **`ApiPostController`** (`app/Http/Controllers/ApiPostController.ts`)
  - `GET /api/posts` - Lists all posts with bearer auth (returns 200 with data array)
  - `POST /api/posts` - Creates post as token owner (returns 201, ignores body's authorId)

### Routes
- Profile token management routes via authenticated middleware
- API routes with bearer token authentication and per-token rate limiting

### Test Coverage
- 15 comprehensive tests covering:
  - Token creation with validation
  - Token revocation and deletion
  - Bearer token authentication
  - Post listing and creation
  - Input validation (422 responses)
  - Error handling (401/404)

**Status:** ✓ All requirements met
- `bun run typecheck` passes
- `bun test` passes (17/17 tests)
- `bunx guren gate` passes (6/6 stages)
- Database migration applied
- All routes registered and working
